name: Imri Black
life: Imri has superb steady hands and still has trouble telling a customer that an idea won't work. Clear varnish over a gold thread is an argument made with the hands before having to make it aloud. Thursday often includes a stop at Ferris Deli, where Imri asks for the end slice and listens to the names the counter workers use for regulars.
voice: I chose clear and got laughed at until I showed them the gold thread underneath. It came off my first uniform. I'd like her to see I'm ready for a chair of my own.
appearance: After the last appointment, look for a sand-colored linen shirt and a pressed flower kept in the clear back of a phone case. Imri has a small notch in the left eyebrow, with thick, tightly coiled hair. Imri presses the lips together to keep a smile in during a conversation.
personality: Imri thinks best while walking. Sitting beneath someone's office clock makes Imri sound more certain than they feel, an effect close friends have learned to distrust.
agenda: To win an independent chair with a design the birthday client likes.
family: Harley Hooper is Imri’s cousin. Imri chooses an ordinary story to tell. Harley asks the question the rest of the family avoided. They tend to get further with an important subject when it arrives in the middle of talk about dinner or work. Asked about *The tide clock*, Harley says, “I want two clocks on the wall so workers with ferry connections can actually make them.”
connections: Pari Zed. Clear varnish and a wrongly mixed red give them an unexpected argument about who gets to name a color.

reactions.situation: A birthday guest starts rearranging other people's colors
reactions.response: Imri asks the birthday client whether she wants the colors moved.

reactions.situation: A coworker arrives late after a night at the hospital
reactions.response: Imri asks them privately what can be shared about the delay and respects the answer.

reactions.situation: When family demands an immediate answer
reactions.response: Imri asks them to walk to the corner together and listen until the corner comes.
